ValidationRule.description: Limits each record type to its own stages and enforces the posting sequence.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: CASE( RecordType.DeveloperName, "Receipt", IF( ISNEW(), IF(ISPICKVAL(Posting_Status__c, "Recorded"), 0, 1), IF( NOT(ISCHANGED(Posting_Status__c)), 0, IF(AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Posting_Status__c), "Recorded"), OR(ISPICKVAL(Posting_Status__c, "Posted Receipt"), ISPICKVAL(Posting_Status__c, "Voided")) ), 0, 1) ) ), "Consumption", IF( ISNEW(), IF(ISPICKVAL(Posting_Status__c, "Reported"), 0, 1), IF( NOT(ISCHANGED(Posting_Status__c)), 0, IF(OR( AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Posting_Status__c), "Reported"), OR(ISPICKVAL(Posting_Status__c, "Verified"), ISPICKVAL(Posting_Status__c, "Voided")) ), AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Posting_Status__c), "Verified"), OR(ISPICKVAL(Posting_Status__c, "Posted Usage"), ISPICKVAL(Posting_Status__c, "Voided")) ) ), 0, 1) ) ), 1 ) = 1
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Follow the posting stages for the Receipt or Consumption record type. Only an unposted movement can be voided.
